{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders: revenue = 999999.99
test_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of internal test orders: {len(test_orders)}')

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders
df_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders): {total_revenue:,.2f}')"}
